name: Screen Time
blurb: Guidelines, background TV, co-viewing and video calls

claims.claim: Screen media should be avoided before 18-24 months
claims.testedAs: Screen media exposure before 18-24 months is associated with worse developmental outcomes

nhs.says: Avoid screens for babies and toddlers. If you do use one, watch together and talk about it so it becomes a shared, interactive activity.

aap.says: Avoid TV and apps before 18 months, apart from video chat with family. Babies learn from real interaction, not from screens.

claims.query: screen media exposure under 2 years infant guidelines outcomes

claims.claim: Background television reduces the quantity and quality of parent-child interaction
claims.testedAs: Background television reduces the quantity and quality of parent-child interaction

nhs.says: Keep screens off in the background. They pull attention away from social interaction and play with your child.

aap.says: A TV on in the background cuts how much a parent talks to a toddler by hundreds of words an hour and delays language.

claims.query: background television parent child interaction infant play quality

claims.claim: Adult co-viewing reduces the negative effects of screen time
claims.testedAs: Adult co-viewing reduces the negative effects of screen time

nhs.says: Watch and talk about content with your child rather than leaving them alone with a screen. It supports development.

aap.says: Children get more out of TV or apps when a parent is watching and using it alongside them.

claims.query: parent co-viewing joint media engagement infant toddler learning outcomes

claims.claim: Video chatting is an acceptable exception to infant screen-time limits
claims.testedAs: Video chatting with a live partner is associated with better outcomes than pre-recorded screen content in infancy

nhs.says: Under 2s should avoid screens except for shared family activities, and video calling relatives is given as an acceptable example.

aap.says: Video chatting with a relative is fine. Sit with your child and keep everyone talking to each other.

claims.query: video chat infant social contingency learning screen exception
